---
title: "Fixing logout to an empty desktop on Omarchy 4.0.1"
status: wip
---

Use this only for the Omarchy 4.0.1 failure mode where **Logout closes the windows but leaves an empty Hyprland desktop instead of ending the session**.

Last checked on 2026-09-05. This is an upstream bug/workaround and may become unnecessary after an Omarchy update.

## check the configured session

Find the SDDM autologin configuration:

```bash
sudo grep -R -n '^Session=' /etc/sddm.conf /etc/sddm.conf.d 2>/dev/null
```

If the active Omarchy autologin entry uses:

```ini
Session=hyprland.desktop
```

then `omarchy-system-logout` may call `uwsm stop` even though the session was not started under UWSM.

Check that the UWSM session exists:

```bash
ls /usr/share/wayland-sessions/hyprland-uwsm.desktop
```

Then edit the active SDDM autologin file and change the session to:

```ini
Session=hyprland-uwsm.desktop
```

Restart SDDM:

```bash
sudo systemctl restart sddm
```

::: {.callout-warning}
Restarting SDDM immediately ends the graphical session. Save your work first.
:::

If normal logout already works, do not make this change just because the note exists.

## reference

- [Omarchy issue #8200: Logout from menu doesn't end session](https://github.com/basecamp/omarchy/issues/8200)
